entities.name: Cetățuia Monastery
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The Cetățuia Monastery is a Romanian Orthodox monastery located 
at 1 Cetățuia Street in Iași, Romania. The monastery is listed in the National Register of Historic Monuments.
